Kerala Assembly Sees Opposition Walkout Over Health Sector Crisis

Opposition parties staged a walkout from the Kerala Assembly, alleging a crisis in the state's health sector. Separately, BJP members protested outside the assembly concerning the detention of R Sugathan under the Kerala Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act (KAAPA).
